sources.name: VPB continuous benchmark (valkey-io CI)
lacks: Server instance type and client host: only the architecture, NUMA node count and CPU ranges are recorded, and the CPU model is empty.
VPB version: metrics.json has no harness commit; the adapter takes it from the workflow run.
Repository: the field is null; the adapter assumes valkey-io/valkey unstable, which the workflow benchmarks.
Config file and key count: rows do not name the config; the adapter takes both from configs/benchmark-config-arm.json.
Run times: every row carries the commit time, so run order is unknown and runs cannot be paired.
Encoding, TTL or expiry mix, server-side throughput and memory: not measured.

ops.name: Throughput, as the client counts it
